decisions.reason: Garage door operators are a core accessory for the residential range, but their absence from the website since 2020 suggests a newer operator generation may soon replace this line.
The solid wood sectional door is a low-volume niche variant that has not appeared on the website for two years, so freeing its resources for the core steel and insulated ranges makes sense.
Glazed industrial doors remain a standard part of the portfolio, but overlap with the similar models E and F makes consolidation a real possibility.
The insulated glazed version fits rising energy-efficiency requirements and the firm's thermal focus, so it is the most likely of the glazed doors to stay.
This glazed industrial door was featured on its own page and is likely a lead model, though its absence from the website since 2020 points to some risk of a successor replacing it.
